description_en: Queries the list of recoverable database backups
description_zh: 查询可恢复数据库备份列表
name: DescribeUniRecoverableList

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the anti-ransomware backup policy for the database.
Call the [DescribeUniBackupPolicies](~~DescribeUniBackupPolicies~~) operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
数据库防勒索备份策略的ID。
调用[DescribeUniBackupPolicies](~~DescribeUniBackupPolicies~~)接口可以获取该参数
parameters.name: policy_id

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of entries to display per page in a paged query. The default number of entries per page is 20. If PageSize is left empty, 20 entries are returned by default.
Set PageSize to a non-empty value
parameters.help_zh:
指定分页查询时，每页显示的数据最大条数。每页默认显示的数据条数为20条，PageSize参数值为空时，将默认返回20条数据。
建议PageSize取值不要为空
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The number of the page from which query results start to be displayed. Default value: 1. This value indicates that the results start from page 1
parameters.help_zh: 设置从返回结果的第几页开始显示查询结果。默认值为1，表示从第1页开始显示
parameters.name: current_page

Count.description_en: The number of recoverable database backup snapshots displayed on the current page
Count.description_zh: 当前页面显示的可恢复数据库备份快照的数量

CurrentPage.description_en: The page number of the current page in a paged query
CurrentPage.description_zh: 分页查询时，显示的当前页的页码

PageSize.description_en: The number of recoverable database backup snapshots displayed per page in a paged query
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时，每页显示的可恢复数据库备份快照的数量

RecoverableInfoList.description_en: The list of recoverable database backup snapshots
RecoverableInfoList.description_zh: 可恢复数据库备份快照列表

items.description_en: The information about a recoverable database backup snapshot
items.description_zh: 可恢复数据库备份快照信息

FirstTime.description_en: The timestamp of the first backup, in milliseconds
FirstTime.description_zh: 开始备份的时间戳，单位：毫秒

LastTime.description_en: The timestamp of the most recent backup, in milliseconds
LastTime.description_zh: 最新备份的时间戳，单位：毫秒

ResetScn.description_en: The reset_scn value of the selected record among the recoverable points in time when querying backups for an Oracle database
ResetScn.description_zh: 针对Oracle数据库查询备份时，对应查询可恢复的时间点中所选择记录的reset_scn值

ResetTime.description_en: The reset_time value of the selected recoverable point in time when querying backups for an Oracle database. The format is YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss
ResetTime.description_zh: 针对 Oracle 数据库查询备份时，表示所选可恢复时间点记录的 reset_time 值，格式为 YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss

RestoreInfo.description_en:
The database recovery information when the database type to restore is MSSQL. The value is a JSON string. Valid values:
name: the database name.
files: the database file path
RestoreInfo.description_zh:
恢复数据库类型为MSSQL时，数据库恢复信息。格式为JSON字符串格式，取值：
name：数据库名称
files：数据库文件路径

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. The ID is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request. You can use the ID to troubleshoot and locate issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of recoverable database backup snapshots returned by the query
TotalCount.description_zh: 查询到的可恢复数据库备份快照的总数量
